svg.title: How often a pure zoom is reported as a dolly
svg.desc: Share of zoom clips with no dolly that each arm reports as a dolly. On unseen scenes: our head 15% and 5% (two seeds) against 75% for Depth Anything 3 plus rules. Numbers are in REPORT.md and results/by_type.csv.
